crossRefs.note: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,
He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to…
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in…
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people.
God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

translations.web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
translations.bsb: A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD.
translations.kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
translations.asv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; But victory is of Jehovah.
